heroHeadline: Russian 'Double-Tap' Drone Strike on Kryvyi Rih Mall Kills 16+, Wounds 130+ as Massive Barrage Also Hits Kyiv
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,641 (August 22, 2026), Russia struck the Solnechnaya Galereya shopping mall in Kryvyi Rih — President Zelensky's hometown — with a 'double-tap' drone attack on August 21 that killed at least 16 people and injured 130+, including 23 children, with 9 still missing. The same day a Russian Shahed strike on Tokarivka in Mykolaiv region killed 4, including 3 children. Two days earlier, Russia launched an hours-long ballistic-missile-and-drone barrage on Kyiv (August 20) that killed 15 and damaged a children's hospital, while Ukraine's intelligence confirmed Russia's first delivery of North Korean KN-30 ballistic missiles to Voronezh Oblast. Overnight into August 22, Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv's Darnytskyi district (1 killed) as Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Ozon warehouse and the Novokuibyshevsk oil refinery in Samara region for the first time. Russian cumulative personnel losses reached approximately 1,475,270 by August 22, per the Ukrainian General Staff.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, CNN, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, Kyiv Post, Euronews, PBS NewsHour, GlobalSecurity.org, United24 Media, Wikipedia War Timeline, and the Ukrainian General Staff. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
